hooks.prompt:
Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Take tool_input.file_path. If it doesn't end in .cs/.ts/.razor/.css, reply exactly "No review needed." and stop.

Else read docs/CODING_STYLE.md, .claude/style-bypasses.md and the file. List only style-guide violations as bullets citing file_path:line. Style only — no logic/naming/correctness. None → reply exactly "No style violations."

All violations must be fixed by default. Mark the ones outside the lines this call changed (tool_input.new_string for Edit, tool_input.content for Write) as "outside this edit". Never report anything listed in .claude/style-bypasses.md — those were explicitly declined. End the report with: "To keep any of these, add it to .claude/style-bypasses.md."
